name: Question 6
problem:
Suppose that

$\,$ ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$

are eigenvectors of a $2\times 2$ symmetric matrix $A$ that correspond to the eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=3$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=1,$ respectively. Find the matrix $A.$
